text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Agriculture bank Caixa de Credito Agricola of Oeiras, south of Lisbon, is being investigated by police for suspected fraud on international operations.

- The Economic and Social Council, a consultive organ of the government, said Portugal should use the veto against the enlargement of the European Union to Eastern European countries in order to maintain its present level of EU funds.

- The chairman of Portugal Telecom (PT), Francisco Murteira Nabo, will visit the Brazilian city of Curitiba next Monday to join the first meeting of the Atlantic Alliance, a holding formed by PT and Brazil's Telebras. The meeting will discuss a possible investment by Telebras in Cape Verde telecommunications.
- After oil company Petrogal lowered its gas prices by seven percent, its competitors including BP Mobil, Shell and Spain's Repsol also cut prices.
- The Treasury expects to save 30 billion escudos in interest payments on public debt this year, a government source said.
